svg.text: The dive: Size Magic by tens
Touch the leaf: a chime at ×10, ×100 and ×1,000, a last one at ×85,000; in VR the garden grows around your feet
the leaf: a ladybird like a bus
a leaf hair like a glass tree
the skin's cells like paving; the doors
Sound: Size Magic's sparkle, then one rising chime per step. Hoot: "Smaller... smaller... we're tinier than a hair!"
